planned_checks.name: json_parse_check
planned_checks.fail_if: ConvertFrom-Json fails for any JSON artifact

planned_checks.name: forbidden_path_check
planned_checks.fail_if: path contains session JSONL, JSONL, screenshot, raw log, or credential markers

planned_checks.name: trailing_whitespace_check
planned_checks.fail_if: any line ends with trailing space or tab

planned_checks.name: generic_pass_forbidden_check
planned_checks.fail_if: generic PASS appears as status without SHAPE_ONLY context

planned_checks.name: gmut_gate_effect_invariant_check
planned_checks.fail_if: gmut_gate_effect is missing or not none_open_not_tested

planned_checks.name: mutation_claim_check
planned_checks.fail_if: cleanup, connector write, cloud mutation, or automation mutation is claimed as performed
